Run up the endless stairs!

No timer.
instructions: Tap or click a column to drop the block shown next to the board. Swipe left or right, or press the TILT buttons, to slide every row to that wall. The SMASH button removes any single block: press it, then tap the block. Keyboard: arrow keys or 1-5 choose a column, Space drops, Q and E tilt, P opens the menu.
